nuggets.text: The Jayhawks won the very first Border War, 22-10, on Halloween 1891 in Kansas City, Missouri.
The Jayhawks haven't hosted Missouri since Oct. 29, 2005, and they won that one 13-3.
When Belgium's king asked for an American college yell at the 1920 Olympics, athletes gave him the Jayhawks' Rock Chalk chant.
The Jayhawk wears shoes because Maloy, who gave the bird its pair, said they were 'for kicking opponents, of course.'
The Jayhawks' stadium opened in 1921 as a World War I memorial and is widely recognized as the oldest west of the Mississippi.
Construction has trimmed the Jayhawks' stadium to 32,000 seats this season; it's set to grow to 43,000 in 2027.
Jayhawks coach Lance Leipold won six national titles in eight seasons at Division III Wisconsin-Whitewater.
Lance Leipold became the fastest head coach in NCAA history, at any level, to reach 100 wins, doing it in 106 games.
The Jayhawks piled up 613 yards and got 86 players into their 51-6 opening rout of LIU.
Isaiah Marshall went 14-for-19 for 246 yards and two touchdowns in his first start at quarterback for the Jayhawks.
